print_metrics()
# Q1: physical J is changed, not all time constants scaled.
P1=plant(J=.03);z=min(-ct.poles(P1).real);kp=abs(1/ct.evalfr((s+z)/s*P1,30j))
print('Q1 denominator',P1.den[0][0],'poles',ct.poles(P1),'P50 PM,wc',ct.margin(50*P1)[1::2],'PI kp,ki,PM,wc',kp,kp*z,ct.margin(kp*(s+z)/s*P1)[1::2]);print('Q1 full PI roots',ct.poles(ct.feedback(kp*(s+z)/s*P1)))
z=min(-ct.poles(G).real);kp=abs(1/ct.evalfr((s+z)/s*G,55j));print('Q2 PI kp,ki,PM,wc',kp,kp*z,ct.margin(kp*(s+z)/s*G)[1::2]);print('Q2 full roots',ct.poles(ct.feedback(kp*(s+z)/s*G)))
print('Q3 phi70 alpha',(1+np.sin(np.deg2rad(70)))/(1-np.sin(np.deg2rad(70))),'alpha20 phi',np.degrees(np.arcsin(19/21)))
print('Q4 ideal PID zero magnitudes',-np.roots([.3,5,5.5]))
P7=10/((s+1)*(s+5)*(s+50));C7=1250/s*(1+s)/(1+s/5)*(1+s/.01)/(1+s/.0002)
print('Q7 original finite DC Kv',0,'alternative Kv',1250*ct.dcgain(P7))
gm,pm,_,wc=ct.margin(C7*P7);print('Q7 integral extension GMdB,PM,wc',20*np.log10(gm),pm,wc,'closed roots',ct.poles(ct.feedback(C7*P7)))
print('Q8 PI5,25 roots',np.roots([1,100.1,5110,25000]))
print('Q8 P load DC for K50',-10000/(110+1000*50))
for fs in [500,5000]:print('Q9',discrete_metrics(fs))
P10=5/((s+2)*(s+20));kp=abs(1/ct.evalfr((s+2)/s*P10,10j));C10=kp*(s+2)/s
print('Q10 P strict lower gain',99/ct.dcgain(P10),'PI kp,ki',kp,2*kp,'metrics',metrics(C10,P10))
# A lead attempt is evaluated too; this is not a claim of exhaustive optimal design.
C10lead=800*(1+s/5)/(1+s/100)
print('Q10 lead fixed attempt',metrics(C10lead,P10))
print('Q10 P800 fixed attempt',metrics(ct.tf([800],[1]),P10))
